# cdnbuild.net
> CDNBuild provides a browser-based JavaScript package CDN with versioned URLs, ESM support, and package metadata endpoints.

The site serves npm packages over a fast CDN and offers package browsing, version selection, and importable build URLs for frontend applications.

## Package Browser
- [Browse Packages](https://cdnbuild.net/): Search and explore npm packages available through CDNBuild.
- [React Package](https://cdnbuild.net/react): Package page with available versions and CDN import URLs.
- [Vue Package](https://cdnbuild.net/vue): Package page showing versioned builds and browser import options.
- [Lodash Package](https://cdnbuild.net/lodash): Package details and CDN delivery paths for lodash releases.
- [Three Package](https://cdnbuild.net/three): Package page for three.js builds and versioned asset access.

## Versioned Package URLs
- [React Latest Build](https://cdnbuild.net/react): Unpinned package URL resolving to the latest available react build.
- [React 18.2.0](https://cdnbuild.net/react@18.2.0): Version-pinned URL for reproducible react imports.
- [Vue 3.4.0](https://cdnbuild.net/vue@3.4.0): Version-specific vue package delivery URL.
- [Lodash 4.17.21](https://cdnbuild.net/lodash@4.17.21): Fixed lodash version URL for stable browser usage.
- [Three 0.160.0](https://cdnbuild.net/three@0.160.0): Pinned three.js package URL for deterministic builds.

## File and Entry Resolution
- [React JSX Runtime](https://cdnbuild.net/react/jsx-runtime): Subpath export for React JSX runtime usage.
- [React DOM Client](https://cdnbuild.net/react-dom/client): Subpath entry for React DOM client rendering APIs.
- [Lodash Debounce](https://cdnbuild.net/lodash/debounce): Direct file-style import path for a specific lodash utility.
- [Three Examples Module](https://cdnbuild.net/three/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js): Deep file path access for package-contained modules.
- [Vue Runtime ESM Build](https://cdnbuild.net/vue/dist/vue.runtime.esm-browser.js): Direct asset path for a specific distributed build file.

## Metadata Endpoints
- [React Metadata](https://cdnbuild.net/react?meta): Package metadata including files and resolved entry information.
- [Vue Metadata](https://cdnbuild.net/vue?meta): Metadata response for vue package contents and resolution details.
- [Lodash Metadata](https://cdnbuild.net/lodash?meta): Package metadata endpoint for lodash files and package information.
- [Three Metadata](https://cdnbuild.net/three?meta): Metadata for three.js package structure and available files.
- [React 18.2.0 Metadata](https://cdnbuild.net/react@18.2.0?meta): Version-specific metadata for a pinned react release.

## Scoped Packages
- [Types React](https://cdnbuild.net/@types/react): Scoped package page for React TypeScript definitions.
- [Babel Standalone](https://cdnbuild.net/@babel/standalone): Scoped package delivery for Babel standalone builds.
- [TanStack React Query](https://cdnbuild.net/@tanstack/react-query): Scoped package page for React Query browser imports.
- [Lit HTML](https://cdnbuild.net/lit-html): Package page for lit-html module delivery.
- [Sentry Browser](https://cdnbuild.net/@sentry/browser): Scoped package URL for Sentry browser SDK builds.

## Common Frontend Libraries
- [Preact](https://cdnbuild.net/preact): Package page for Preact browser-ready module imports.
- [Svelte](https://cdnbuild.net/svelte): Package page for Svelte package files and versioned URLs.
- [Axios](https://cdnbuild.net/axios): Package page for Axios browser and ESM builds.
- [Day.js](https://cdnbuild.net/dayjs): Package page for Day.js lightweight date library delivery.
- [Zod](https://cdnbuild.net/zod): Package page for Zod schema validation package imports.

## Framework and Tooling Packages
- [Next](https://cdnbuild.net/next): Package page for Next.js package browsing and file access.
- [Vite](https://cdnbuild.net/vite): Package page for Vite package files and versioned delivery.
- [TypeScript](https://cdnbuild.net/typescript): Package page for TypeScript compiler package assets.
- [Esbuild](https://cdnbuild.net/esbuild): Package page for esbuild package metadata and files.
- [Rollup](https://cdnbuild.net/rollup): Package page for Rollup package delivery and version browsing.

## Utility and UI Packages
- [Tailwind CSS](https://cdnbuild.net/tailwindcss): Package page for Tailwind CSS package assets.
- [PostCSS](https://cdnbuild.net/postcss): Package page for PostCSS package browsing and imports.
- [RxJS](https://cdnbuild.net/rxjs): Package page for RxJS modules and versioned CDN URLs.
- [Framer Motion](https://cdnbuild.net/framer-motion): Package page for Framer Motion package delivery.
- [Shadcn UI](https://cdnbuild.net/shadcn-ui): Package page for shadcn-ui package assets and versions.
